newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle trade at $101/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle trade at $101/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers on a live basis were near steady; dressed basis steady to $1.00 per cwt lower, USDA said.
Confirmed - 11,000 Last Week - 38,000 Last Year- 41,700 Wk To Date- 60,000 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 79,200 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 50,500
Demand was fair to good. Seller interest fair. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs - 62.00-64.00; dressed basis 100.00-101.00. ( weighted average 100.61). Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1225 lbs - 62.00-64.00; dressed basis 100.00-101.00. ( weighted average 100.58).
